source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: All Correct Answers to Gentle Thief's Questions (Honor Among Thieves)
source_excerpt:
After reaching the second region, Crimson Forest , players will eventually make their way to the Thieves' Camp , where they can find the Gentle Thief. If you have accepted the Honor Among Thieves quest, he will ask Soul a series of questions that you must answer correctly to earn his trust.
There are three questions in total, each with four possible answers, which can be confusing if you do not know where to find the clues. This guide explains how to start the quest and provides all the correct answers to the Gentle Thief's questions.
Honor Among Thieves Quest Walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
Image via GameRant | Sources: S-GAME
As you reach the Outlaw Trap Bell, head right, ignoring the boss arena on your left and the mechanism that requires the Crimson Forest Tunnel Crank . Take another left to find a body with a letter on it. Pick up the letter to start the Honor Among Thieves quest.
The letter provides information about the Nimble Thief , and reading it carefully will give you the clues needed to answer the Gentle Thief's questions. Since a difficult boss blocks the path ahead toward the Thieves' Camp, you might forget about the letter as you continue through the region. However, make sure to collect it before moving on to the main story path, as it contains the information required for the quest.
All Correct Answers to the Gentle Thief's Questions in Phantom Blade Zero
Once you reach the Thieves' Camp, head inside the tent where you will find the Gentle Thief. If you have started Honor Among Thieves, speaking to him will begin the question sequence. Here are all three questions and their correct answers.
What did the Nimble Thief do at 13 that he never stopped bragging about?
Stole a landowner's jade belt (Correct Answer)
What was the head of the Hairpin that doomed him for life?
What became of the poor family's child?
The letter never said. His fate is unknown. (Correct Answer)
After answering all three questions correctly, the Gentle Thief will reward you with the Silent Wrap accessory. This accessory reduces noise from footsteps and Assassinations by 40%, making it useful for players who prefer a stealthier approach.
If you answer any questions incorrectly, there is no need to worry. You can attempt the questions again, so simply retry until you select all three correct answers and claim your reward.
